Declared as an Individual, but the trading name 'Anything Worxx inc.' claims to be a corporation. The NC Secretary of State business search page states automated or scripted searches are not permitted, so no registry query was run; indexed results showed no NC entity named Anything Worxx/Worx/Works. The Town of Waynesville taxi ordinance requires a certificate of public convenience and necessity and a driver taxi permit for passengers carried for hire within town limits; no public permit register exists to check. [https://www.sosnc.gov/online_services/search]

No listing, Facebook page, Google Business presence or directory entry places 'Anything Worxx' as a ride or taxi service in Waynesville / Haywood County. Service business without licensed premises: no points.
